# `ping` check

Send ICMP echo requests and check packet loss and round-trip time.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: ping
    host: 10.0.0.1
    count: 5
    expect:
      loss: { warn: 0%, fail: 50% }
      rtt: { warn: 50ms, fail: 200ms }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` **(required)** | string |  | Host or IP to ping. |
| `count` | integer | `3` | Number of echo requests. |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.loss` | {warn, fail} percent | `{warn: 0%, fail: 50%}` | Packet loss limits. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |
| `expect.rtt` | {warn, fail} duration |  | Average round-trip time limits. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check ping <host> [--set key=value ...]`
